Loonbeslag.title: Loonbeslag
Loonbeslag.description: A court/deurwaarder-ordered wage garnishment (derdenbeslag): an ongoing order spanning many periods until the claim is satisfied or the order is withdrawn -- a fundamentally different lifecycle from a PayrollAdjustment's one-shot correction (design.md D1). PayrollRunService folds the floor-clamped periodic deduction into Payslip.nettoPay as a fourth current-run post-tax component (loonbeslag), never re-invoking PayrollCalculator. beslagvrijeVoet is a required, HR-entered stored input for the MVP -- computing it per the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet is a named fast-follow (design.md D7). status is a plain enum, deliberately no x-openregister-lifecycle map (design.md D5): the sensitive activate/settle/withdraw transitions require a caller-role (admin/HR) check a lifecycle guard's (object, action, userId) contract cannot express, so LoonbeslagController owns every transition instead.

creditor.description: The creditor/deurwaarder name named on the garnishment order.

dossierRef.description: The deurwaarder's dossier/case reference -- the human key an HR user matches against the court order.

orderedAmount.description: The periodic deduction amount the order specifies, euro -- the un-clamped figure before the beslagvrije-voet floor is applied (design.md D2).

beslagvrijeVoet.description: The protected minimum, euro -- a stored HR-entered input for the MVP, trusted as the authoritative figure the deurwaarder is legally required to state on the order (design.md D7). Computing it from income/household composition per the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet is a named fast-follow, not implemented here.

status.description: Plain enum, deliberately no x-openregister-lifecycle map (design.md D5): activate (concept -> actief), settle (actief -> voldaan), and withdraw (concept/actief -> ingetrokken) are each a guarded LoonbeslagController endpoint (admin/HR gate BEFORE any RBAC resolve), never a bare lifecycleActions transition.

effectiveFrom.description: First period the deduction may apply.

effectiveTo.description: Last period the deduction may apply, or null while open-ended.

activatedBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the admin/HR principal who verified and activated this garnishment (LoonbeslagController::activate()).

settledBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the admin/HR principal who marked this garnishment settled (LoonbeslagController::settle()).

settledAt.description: When this garnishment was marked settled (the claim satisfied).

withdrawnBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the admin/HR principal who withdrew this garnishment (LoonbeslagController::withdraw()).

withdrawnReason.description: Free-text reason the garnishment was withdrawn, stamped by LoonbeslagController::withdraw().
